meta.parties: Carolis Et Al. v. Don Davith

rules.statement: A deed of gift, even with a reservation of power to revoke in case of misconduct, vests the property immediately in the donees upon acceptance and does not allow revocation without alleging misconduct.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold accordingly that the judgment under appeal should be set aside, and judgment given declaring the plaintiffs entitled to the shares claimed."
